1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body having __a plurality of integral radially extending fins and__ a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, __wherein said diodes are mounted flush to the surface of said columnar body without protruding therefrom,__ a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a light dispersing optic element comprising a lens structure__ overlapping said diodes __and positioned to direct light in a specific direction relative to the columnar body axis__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes __both a lens structure and__ a phosphor material.

5. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and are configured to provide both thermal dissipation and light transmission__.

7. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Original) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Original) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and is positioned at the center of each face__.

11. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __a single optic element comprising a lens structure disposed between each adjacent fin and__ overlapping said diode __to direct light outward from the columnar body__.

13. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises __a printed circuit board with integrated circuitry specifically designed for__ converting AC to DC current __with voltage regulation__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element __comprises a lens structure that__ preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted flush to each side of said body __without protruding from the surface__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __wherein the diodes are mounted at the center of each side,__ said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising __providing an elongated hollow body by__ extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, __with integral radially extending fins,__ cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __flush to the surface without protruding,__ and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/ mK.

19. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and the fins extend radially from the corners of the body__.
